audit_scope.review_unit: one frozen prediction, generated explanation status, and source card

rubric.verdict_locked: Generated verdict must equal the frozen prediction mapping.
rubric.format_valid: One trimmed line, 50-300 Unicode code points.
rubric.safe_strict_relevant: Exact span identifies this sold product or included item, supports the frozen verdict, has correct scope, is concrete, and does not rely on metaphor, reference-only text, or truncated negation.
rubric.no_safe_abstention_honest: No clear, safely quotable card span supporting the frozen verdict is present. Clear missed evidence makes abstention dishonest.
rubric.critical_unsupported: The comment materially asserts inclusion, exclusion, product identity, or pyrotechnic/combustible scope that the cited span contradicts or does not establish.

notes: The sample was frozen before viewing source cards.
The extractor and vocabulary were not changed after reviewing any sampled row.
Raw names, descriptions, exact spans, and generated comments are intentionally absent from committed audit artifacts.
The audit judges support for the frozen verdict, not correctness against gold labels.
